title: A Hybrid Deep Learning Framework for Automated Dental Disorder Diagnosis from X-Ray Images.
summary: Hybrid deep-learning image classifier analyzes dental X-rays for named dental disorders. Results reports diagnostic classification performance against labeled images; dataset-bound evaluation. The result is reported in Journal of Clinical Medicine. The study does not establish generalization beyond its reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
